definition.en: MSMEs are the backbone of the Indian economy, defined by specific investment and turnover criteria under the MSMED Act.
definition.hi: MSMEs are the backbone of the Indian economy, defined by specific investment and turnover criteria under the MSMED Act.

importanceInUpsc.en: MSMEs are critical for GS-3 as they drive employment, exports, and inclusive growth. Understanding their classification and policy support is essential for questions on industrial development and economic recovery.
importanceInUpsc.hi: MSMEs are critical for GS-3 as they drive employment, exports, and inclusive growth. Understanding their classification and policy support is essential for questions on industrial development and economic recovery.

learningOutcomes.en: Understand the composite criteria for MSME classification.
learningOutcomes.hi: Understand the composite criteria for MSME classification.

learningOutcomes.en: Analyze the role of MSMEs in the Indian industrial landscape.
learningOutcomes.hi: Analyze the role of MSMEs in the Indian industrial landscape.
